Item Class: Maps
Rarity: Normal
Blighted Map (Tier 14)
--------
Map Area: Estuary
--------
Item Level: 85
--------
Monster Level: 81
--------
Area is infested with Fungal Growths
Map's Item Quantity Modifiers also affect Blight Chest count at 25% value
Can be Anointed up to 3 times
Natural inhabitants of this area have been removed
--------
Travel to a Map of this tier or lower by using this in a personal Map Device. Maps can only be used once.
